name: crunch (straight leg up)
description: A crunch with your legs pointing straight up so you reach toward your toes. It works the abs with less hip flexor pull.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms toward your feet.
Curl your shoulders off the floor and reach toward your toes.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Keep your legs still and your neck relaxed.
